text_block_list.text:
One day, I have Мэйсё Дото training in
her
signature racewear to get a sense of
how a real
race might feel.

And... f-finish! I think that was a pretty
good run!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
Maybe your signature racewear had something
to do with it?

text_block_list.text:
I think so too! I feel like I can run faster
with this
on. B-but it could be my
imagination.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm so thankful... They went out of their
way to
design something to my taste.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: What kind of features did you ask for?

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! N-no-nothing in particular, really!
I don't
really understand fashion, let
alone
optimat—optzima...tation?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
S-so everything about my outfit is all
thanks to
the designer. It's easy to run
in, and it looks
lovely, too. I left most of
the decisions to them.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Ah... Umm... I'm sorry... Th-the truth is...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I did ask for one thing. But maybe
someone like
me was better off staying
quiet.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I wanted them to include a bag.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well... it has to do with my childhood,
but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I've been a klutz since I was young.
During
outings, I would trip and fall or
get separated
from the group.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So my mother had me carry around what
she
called a "little bag of help".
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
There was nothing really special inside,
just
bandages, a hand towel, and
contact details.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But she said as long as I had that bag, I'd
be
okay.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I was scared or nervous, I'd
cling on to
that little bag like a security
blanket and do my
best.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So, it was the first thing I thought of
when the
topic of my signature racewear
came up.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I knew that getting racewear meant I'd
be
entering bigger races, and that
they'd probably
be scary...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But with a little bag of help, I'd be brave
enough
to do my best.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Let's clean it up and take good care of it, then.

text_block_list.text:
But with a little bag of help, I'd be brave
enough
to do my best.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Let's clean it up and take good care of it, then.

text_block_list.text: Clean it?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is a little dirty from running just
now.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Wow... I'm amazed. My bag is so shiny!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So it's possible to get your bag
professionally
shined. I didn't know that
was a thing.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, b-but while I was there, the worker
taught me
how to do it myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: From now on, I'll take care of my bag after every race. After all, it's my little bag of help.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, actually, I haven't prepared
anything
yet...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
And so, I bring a somewhat reluctant
Meisho
Doto to the academy's shop.

What to buy... I should get some
bandages and
disinfectant. Oh, if I fall
over, I'll need a towel...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I should get a sewing kit, and another
spare
towel...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Ah!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
A gemstone... keychain? It's so shiny and
cute,
and...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
I think it would work great as a good-luck
charm.

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! W-well, I do want it, but my
budget won't
stretch that far...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
What?! No, b-b-but, I couldn't possibly
let you do
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I want you to be safe when you're running.

text_block_list.text:
No, I'm p-perfectly fine not having it...
Someone
like me doesn't
d-deserve—T-Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Uugh... I'm so happy... Thank you so
much,
Trainer. I promise to take good
care of it.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото clutches her newly cleaned
and
polished bag, tightly cradling it as
she would her
most precious treasure.

Мэйсё Дото carefully puts the key
chain away,
acting true to her words.
